runtime.title: Cloudflare customer email campaigns and reports
notes: Adds the opt-in email-campaigns module with contact imports and preferences, bounded audience rules, structured versioned templates, immutable campaign approvals, captured tests, scheduling, guided transactional workflows, and fresh recurring customer reports.

Adds native Cloudflare structured sending, purpose/evidence checks, durable leases and quotas, uncertain-submission review, native delivery-feedback queues, suppressions, and scoped public preference endpoints that remain usable after sending is disabled. No external email provider or promotional newsletter transport is included.

Adds the server-only encrypted website event outbox and browser-safe confirmed signup helper, an installation plan/apply command, optional additive migrations, private Pages consumer support, and reviewable per-business setup/recovery guidance. Existing installations and forms are never enabled, deployed, or migrated automatically.

contracts.title: Customer email purposes audiences and workflows
notes: Adds typed, validated Cloudflare email settings, contact and permission evidence, segment rules, structured templates, campaign purposes, guided automation steps, website events, workspace responses, and per-account cost calculations.
Adds explicit email permissions excluded from existing non-owner role defaults and identifies the optional compiled email workspace without exposing handlers or credentials in bootstrap metadata.

initializer.title: Initialize with optional customer email guidance
notes: Pins runtime 1.6.0 so new installations receive the optional email setup command, agent guidance, native feedback dispatch support, and compiled email workspace. This initializer update changes the dependency version only; it does not enable the module, provision resources, or send email.
